newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wool prices mixed at Napier, Dunedin sales.
newsitem.headline: NZ wool prices mixed at Napier, Dunedin sales.

text.p: Wool prices were mixed but generally easier at sales in Dunedin and Napier on Thursday, the provisional market indicator falling four cents to 457 NZ cents per kg clean, Wools of New Zealand said.

The 3,296 clean tonnes on offer were mostly made up of 27 percent crossbred fleece, 26 percent merino fleece, 19 percent second shear, six percent halfbred fleece, five percent bulky skirtings, four percent second shear bellies and pieces and two percent lambswool. Seventeen percent of the offer was passed in.
Compared to the last sale on November 14, crossbred fleece 33.7 micron and finer was up to one percent cheaper, 34-35 micron generally unchanged while 36 micron and stronger was slightly cheaper.
Second shear prices fell by up to 2.5 percent.
First lambs wool, 27-28 micron, fell by 2.5 percent, 29 micron was slightly chepaer, bulky skirtings was 2.5-5.0 percent cheaper and second shear bellies and pieces were unchanged.
Interest came from Western Europe, local mills and China, with support on from Turkey, India, Nepal and Japan. The Next sale is on November 28. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
